description.p: A native port of Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 (Xbox 360, Xbox Live Arcade, 2008), rebuilt from reverse engineering of the original executable. It plays the original's six modes (Deadline, King, Evolved, Pacifism, Waves and Sequence), its menus, local score boards and achievements, and local multiplayer for up to four players, at any resolution.
geow2 contains no game data. It needs your own copy of the Xbox Live Arcade release (title ID 584108FF, version 0x102): on first start it asks for the package and makes its data folder from it.
geow2 is an unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Activision, Bizarre Creations or Microsoft. Geometry Wars is a trademark of Activision Publishing, Inc.

Deadline: the last seconds of a three-minute game
King: firing only from inside the zones
Sequence: one of twenty set levels
Local multiplayer: three players in versus

description.p: Leaderboards with the original's cursor and paging; Next Friend and Personal Best at the top right with a score server; online scores sturdier and a long history synced in parts.
Online scores: the Single Player tiles show the group's best six for each mode, and the server's address can be pasted.
Installable from geow2.com with Flatpak, with updates through the software centre.

Optional online scores with a score server for your group of friends: high scores, unlocked modes and achievements shared between your devices, and the group's boards in the game. Setup inside the game, with a gamepad. The mode select menu keeps the mode just played selected.
The first release: all six modes, the front end, local score boards and achievements, and local multiplayer for up to four players.
